```yaml
name: CLI Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage/**/lcov.info
          directory: coverage
          coverage-format: lcov
          disable-search: true
          fail-ci-if-error: true
          verbose: true
          name: codecov
          base-branch: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          junit-xml-pattern: '**/test-results.xml'
          enable-tests: true
          enable-coverage: true
          handle-no-reports-found: ignore
          flags: cli

  publish:
    name: Publish @prpm/cli
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          token: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build packages
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish @prpm/cli
        run: npm publish --access public --workspace=@prpm/cli
```
